sources.name: Austin Dance Socials
sources.notes: Primary seed. Static HTML grouped by day of week, no API/JSON feed. Their /about states they monitor "30+ Instagram accounts" and refresh weekly (IG), monthly (full), quarterly (venue audit) — as of Jul 2026: 119 events / 46 venues. Treat as the schedule backbone.

sources.name: Salsa Vida (Austin guide)
sources.notes: National salsa media site; the IG account is global, not Austin-specific.

sources.name: Do512
sources.notes: General Austin events. Also has TikTok @do512austin. Good for venue cross-refs.

sources.name: Rhythm House ATX
sources.notes: TikTok @rhythm.house.atx. Co-owners Lizeth Katz Pallagi, Lisa Vargas, Travis Herman.

sources.name: Pasión Latina Dance Company
sources.notes: This is your "PassionLatin" — no Austin org is spelled "Passion Latin". Directed by Lisa Vargas, who co-owns Rhythm House ATX; performance teams showcase at Echale Salsita socials. IG display name reads "Lisa Vargas".

sources.name: Austin Inspired Movement
sources.address: 4201 S Congress Ave Suite 108, Austin TX 78745
sources.notes: Also YouTube @InspiredMovementAustin, TikTok @austininspiredmovement, FB /austininspiredmovement.

sources.name: BeBachata Austin
sources.notes: Classes run at Blue Moon Dance Studio, S Lamar. Site's meta tags only expose X/@BeBachata, not the IG handle — hence profile_indexed rather than site_link. passion.io is just their course host, unrelated to Pasión Latina.

sources.name: Echale Salsita Austin Social
sources.notes: FB /EchaleSalsitaAustin. Hosts showcases for Pasión Latina teams.

sources.name: Planet Music ATX
sources.notes: Not on your list — surfaced as the organizer behind Cabana Club's Salsa/Bachata Sundays and Wednesdays.

sources.name: Yatin & Nikol
sources.notes: Touring bachata duo — relevant to Austin only as visiting artists.

sources.name: Julie "Jewlz" Fletch Hansen
sources.home_base: Utah (per third-party credit); appears on LA Bachata Festival roster
sources.notes: Individual bachata instructor. No Austin affiliation found.

sources.name: Cabana Club Austin
sources.notes: Watch out — three near-identical handles exist. The site footer links @cabanaclubatx; @cabanaclub.atx also exists; TikTok and the Linktree slug are @cabanaclubaustin. Use cabanaclubatx.

sources.name: Esquina Tango
sources.notes: Older account @esquinatangoaustin still exists; current footer points to @esquinatango.

sources.name: Blue Moon Dance Co.
sources.notes: Hosts BeBachata Austin classes.

sources.name: Gloria's Latin Cuisine — The Domain
sources.notes: Brand-wide account is @gloriaslatincuisine; use the Austin nightlife one.

sources.name: The White Horse
sources.notes: Two-step lessons are run by Dancin' Austin (@dancinaustin), not the venue.

sources.name: Mavericks Dance Hall (Pflugerville)
sources.notes: Do not confuse with @mavericksthecolony (different location).

sources.name: The Broken Spoke
sources.notes: Site footer lists only Facebook + YouTube; handle inferred from domain match.

sources.name: Avila Soccer & Dance Hall
sources.notes: Operator account is probably @avilacreativesoccer but unverified — site blocks crawling via robots.txt. Dance nights are run by Dance U2 (danceu2.com), which lists no Instagram.

sources.name: Hancock Recreation Center
sources.notes: City facility, no venue-level account. Dept account is @austincityparks.

sources.name: Cherrywood Hall
sources.notes: No venue found under this exact name. Closest is Cherrywood Center (1605 E 38½ St) with an IG titled @thecherrywoodcenter — name mismatch, needs a human eyeball before wiring in.
